authority: Researcher's current end-to-end English execution contract; no financial expenditure, fabricated consent, historical changes or automatic Git operations.
scope: One English original-language authentic-speaker S/F/H generation programme under Protocol v1.1 with prospective stage-specific amendments. Japanese results remain historical; no translation of that corpus.

alternatives.value: Repeated genuine speakers and surveys directly match persona modelling.
alternatives.boundary: Requires truthful institutional application and distributor approval; no approval or access has been fabricated.

alternatives.path: Original SwDA transcripts with verified speaker/date metadata
alternatives.value: Large repeated-speaker sample, English conversational topics, potential speaker-disjoint factorial and replication cohorts.
alternatives.boundary: ConvoKit states CC BY-NC-SA3; original distribution/metadata and conversion attribution require checking. Demographics are not a substitute for meaningful personal facts. Exclude Penn Treebank parses and processed disfluency-stripped corpus.

alternatives.value: Authentic recurring English speakers, dated professional dialogue, official CC BY4 transcript release.
alternatives.boundary: Meeting-domain population; real professional self-reports must be present, not invented. Speaker/meeting overlap and eligible cohort size require qualification.

qualification_limits.downloads: Only openly distributed text/metadata needed for two leading candidates, in private local paths; no audio/video, private messages, identity enrichment, gated-access bypass or external redistribution.
qualification_limits.speaker_content: Inspect metadata before targets. Do not read reserved Japanese58 targets. No English validation target split is claimed frozen yet.
qualification_limits.facts: Require explicit, nonsensitive, speaker-attributed source-grounded statements or adequately documented metadata. Distinguish a self-report from independently verified world truth; never infer missing personal facts.
qualification_limits.style: Derive from earlier development dialogue; exclude semantic facts from style instructions. Length, lexical copying and formatting alone cannot establish fidelity.
qualification_limits.history: Use real dated earlier dialogue; no chronology from absent timestamps, ID order or fabricated updates.
qualification_limits.privacy: Pseudonymous local research only; avoid identity linkage, sensitive attributes and third-party private information; no deployed impersonation. A copyright licence is not comprehensive privacy clearance or specific modern generative consent.
qualification_limits.evaluation: Genuine English human judgments are needed for open-ended fidelity/relevance/coherence claims. Objective measurements must have a frozen applicability rule and must not be relabelled semantic validity. No unvalidated AI labels as human references.
qualification_limits.model: Reuse verified CPU artifacts if scientifically suitable. Check current RAM before model loading; do not lower an existing model/configuration safety envelope or kill other applications.
qualification_limits.stopping: Do not spend inference until dataset, privacy, case provenance, endpoint applicability and model-specific RAM prerequisites all pass. A real unresolved prerequisite is not permission to simulate completion. Do not exhaust the allowance on a weaker surrogate project.

resource_planning_not_authorized_run.preferred_balanced_main: Up to256 development and192 independent replication generations if qualified speaker/context counts and valid endpoints justify them; not a quota or frozen sample.
resource_planning_not_authorized_run.reserve: At least64 of512 remaining requests outside those main batches, for essential controls or later justified work; all allocations remain cumulative.
resource_planning_not_authorized_run.final_freeze_required: Actual speakers, cases, development/validation isolation, eight conditions, prompts, endpoints, scorer, inference configuration and finite bounds before any inference.

rq_boundaries.RQ1: Full S/F/H main and interaction effects are the intended central estimands; not replaced by recognition bias or surface distance.
rq_boundaries.RQ2: Historical consistency only where source validity supports it; natural temporal change is not presumed.
rq_boundaries.RQ3: Model-size/Base-Instruct conclusions require an actual controlled model comparison; one-model data cannot answer this.
rq_boundaries.RQ4: Retrieval/ranking/LoRA require separate fair comparisons after interpretable baseline failures; none is claimed executed or novel.
